answer: Admission charges a per-identity bond of 400 credits, escrowed for 30 days and released only after 5 distinct verifiers sign the identity's first settled task. Verifiers cannot be shared, so each clone repeats the full river of work from zero; coordination cost spirals as the fleet grows. Sybil farming an orchard of fakes pays 400,000 credits in locked bonds to chase at most 50,000 in rewards, while an honest identity risks one bond. Net loss per fake, cost grows linearly - the wall, not a toll.
